requirements.operator: Desktop Chromium with WebGL; authorized text and work details remain usable without WebGL.
requirements.narrow_layout: 390 CSS pixel viewport; browser emulation does not establish physical Android acceptance.
requirements.collection: Existing signed d-patch location protocol. This profile adds no device or hardware-tracker protocol.
requirements.map_coverage: Bundled Natural Earth imagery for global orientation. Street detail, geocoding, routing and terrain measurements are unavailable.
requirements.offline: Static assets may be packaged locally; protected observations require current online authorization. No offline location cache.

evidence_boundary: Budgets are acceptance limits chosen before this slice's measurements, not observed performance or service-level guarantees. Browser measurements use controlled observations and a loopback fixture. Phoenix/database authorization, field collection and deployment require their separate evidence. No legacy runtime or savings baseline is asserted.
